description: The material is aligned with the official 2026 exam guide and includes scenario-based practice questions, a full-length timed mock exam (60 questions, 120 minutes), detailed answer explanations, and practical strategies for handling both multiple-choice and multiple-response questions. summary:
This is one of the most relevant and practical CCAR-F exam prep resources available in 2026. The course stays focused on real architectural decision-making rather than pure theory — matching the scenario-driven nature of the actual exam (where you face 4 out of 6 randomly selected scenarios).
It emphasizes judgment calls: when to use multi-agent patterns, how to design solid MCP integrations, managing context windows effectively, and avoiding common anti-patterns.
